name: x-reader
description: Read the original source behind a URL (X/Twitter, articles, YouTube, Bilibili, podcasts, WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Telegram, RSS) and report what was actually read versus missing.

interface.shortDescription: Read the original source behind a link, with evidence coverage
interface.longDescription: x-reader reads X/Twitter posts, articles, videos, podcasts, WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Telegram and RSS from the original URL, and says which layers (text, attached media, transcript) were actually read and which are missing.
defaultPrompt: Read this link and tell me what it actually says.
